name: 11355 · Flushing, NY
findings: ZIP 11355 (Flushing) has 239 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 60 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11355 (Flushing) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
74% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11355 (Flushing) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 84% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
